note: Doe Mountain Recreation Authority campground on Roan Creek near Butler, a short ride from the Morefield Branch trailhead of Doe Mountain's ATV/UTV, bike and hiking trails (OHVs may drive only to and from the trail route); cabins, tent sites, bathhouse. RVs are temporarily limited to 20 ft while a temporary bridge carries the entry road. --Claude
summary: Roan Creek/DMRA: dmra.gov/camping + map, Wayback of the old page, RoverPass claimed listing, Esri. $40-45 confirmed; 9 RV sites (+2 add-on pads); RoverPass booking, 14-night limit; dump confirmed. Current page still says 'Due to the temporary bridge, RVs are limited to 20 feet in length.' -> DROP CANDIDATE (temporary). OHV-oriented (flag only). Hookup amps/sewer unconfirmed. Website moved.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (rig length, temporary): dmra.gov/camping (read 2026-11-25) still says '*Due to the temporary bridge, RVs are limited to 20 feet in length.*' (the same restriction was on the page in Aug 2026). A 23-ft rig is over the posted limit. Written as sites.max_rig_ft 20 with the temporary cause in sites.note; under 'add with a caveat' the reviewer may keep it until the bridge is replaced, or drop it.

OHV (flag only, not a drop): the Aug 2026 page called it 'the ultimate basecamp for off-road riders' and 'designed to accommodate off-road riders'; the current page calls it a 'home base for adventure' with RV/cabin/tent camping, and the trailhead is reached 'a short distance ... along Highway 167' (no trail access inside; 'Recreational riding within the campground is prohibited'). Run by the OHV trail authority, so it reads as a trail-system base camp; reviewer decides between that and a general campground with an OHV side.
